one_liner: monday.com has a broad GraphQL API with self-serve OAuth apps, personal tokens, a free developer sandbox, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow works for apps created in the Developer Center (OAuth 2.1 also used for MCP). Personal V2 API tokens are the simpler alternative. JWTs are only for verifying incoming webhooks.
access_notes: A free developer account gives an API token. The pages do not restate plan-level API limits, so those draft details are lower confidence.
blocker_notes: None. Credentials are self-serve and free through the developer account.
